Description: Pascagoula is an industrial Gulf Coast port city in Jackson County and the anchor of Mississippi's defense manufacturing sector, dominated by Huntington Ingalls Industries' Ingalls Shipbuilding, the state's largest private employer and builder of Navy destroyers and amphibious warships. It offers deep coastal affordability with typical home values near $142k, a low regional cost index, Gulf of Mexico waters, and Walmart access. Tradeoffs include hot, muggy summers with heavy rainfall, higher property crime rates, hurricane and coastal storm exposure, lack of a local Costco, and routine VA healthcare requiring travel to the Biloxi VA Medical Center roughly 24 miles west.
